subject: [hw] D01 -> V40: exact /dev/vcu ioctl numbers, open paths and mmap arguments from the vendor binaries
body:
facts/vcu_usage.md is in the tree; script facts/vcu_usage.py reproduces every line. Short version:

OPEN: libvpud_vcodec.so venc_vcodec_msg_handler opens /dev/vcu (O_RDWR) at 0x11bd6 and 0x11bf6; vdec_codec_msg_handler opens /dev/vcu (0xc528) and /dev/vpu (0xc540). /dev/vpu is really opened by the decoder path, but CONFIG_VIDEO_MEDIATEK_VPU is not set in this kernel, so it must fail and the code falls back - provide /dev/vcu, /dev/vpu can be an alias or absent.

IOCTL literals (32-bit _IOC, struct sizes from the 32-bit AAPMCS layout):
  0x40587600 VCU_SET_OBJECT        _IOW ('v',0,share_obj 0x58)   at venc_vcodec_msg_handler 0x13cb4
  0xc0207606 VCU_PA_ALLOCATION     _IOWR('v',6,mem_obj 0x20)     at eVideoMemAlloc 0x17f3e
  0xc0207607 VCU_PA_FREE           _IOWR('v',7,mem_obj)          at eVideoMemFree 0x18444
  0x40207608 VCU_GCE_SET_CMD_FLUSH _IOW ('v',8,gce_cmdq_obj 0x20) at eVideoSetGCECmdFlush 0x18ba0
  0x40107609 VCU_GCE_WAIT_CALLBACK _IOW ('v',9,gce_obj 0x10)     at eVideoWaitGCECallBack 0x18cac
VCU_GET_OBJECT (expected 0xc058760a, 0x58 payload) never appears as a literal: md32_ipi_send 0x14544 and send_obj 0x1459a pass r1 from the ipi object/parameter. Implement it anyway - that is the receive path.

Not VCU, do not route: 0x40044d34/0x40044d35 (ION custom, magic M) and 0x40106600/0x80106602/0x40046601 on /dev/mtk_sched (magic f).

MMAP: vdec_drv_init_hw_info 0x1e1ea does mmap(NULL, 0x40000, PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, fd, 0x16000000) - offset is the VDEC register base, exactly what mtk_vcu_mmap()+vcu_check_reg_base() expect (pa_start < MAP_PA_BASE_1GB 0x40000000, inside map_base[] and vcuid==0). eVideoMemMAP 0x1822a and eVideoMMAP 0x19a40 map shared buffers with computed offsets (page-aligned iova / MAP_SHMEM_* bases) - plain guest memory is right for those.
Open items: libvcodecdrv.so (encoder-side register mmap) was not in my scan set; if you need its base/offset I can add it.
